# The fish: a faceted mint body 0.6 long (along x), flat sides facing +-Y (hedra), a forked tail fin,
# a dorsal fin, a dark eye each side. Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Scale --base-color 0.188 0.882 0.725 --no-slot
material new Fin --base-color 0.055 0.686 0.608 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.255 0.114 0.192 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5
scale 0.62 0.2 0.3
apply --scale
material assign Scale
add mesh cone --name Tail --vertices 3 --radius1 0.2 --radius2 0.0 --depth 0.24 --location 0.36 0 0 --rotation 0 -90 0
apply --rotation
scale 1 0.35 1.35
apply --scale
material assign Fin
add mesh cone --name Dorsal --vertices 3 --radius1 0.12 --radius2 0 --depth 0.13 --location -0.02 0 0.17
scale 1.6 0.4 1
apply --scale
material assign Fin
add mesh cube --name EyeL --size 0.08 --location -0.17 -0.085 0.04
material assign Eye
add mesh cube --name EyeR --size 0.08 --location -0.17 0.085 0.04
material assign Eye
select all
shade flat
export fish.glb
